name: RMG worker, grade G3 at Tk 13,550, full month with two absent days, a half day, a day of leave without pay and a day of paid leave
source: hand-worked from the BD pack rules
working: Grade G3 minimum is gross 13550 and basic 7400: met
Employed all 31 days, so the structure lines are paid in full; absence and leave without pay are deducted separately, per day of a 30-day month
Absent days = 2 (7 and 8 Oct) + 0.5 (half day on 14 Oct) = 2.5
ABSENCE = round(BASIC ÷ 30 × absent days) = round(7400 ÷ 30 × 2.5) = round(616.67) = 617
Days of leave without pay = 1 (21 Oct); the paid leave day (26 Oct) deducts nothing
UNPAID_LEAVE = round(GROSS ÷ 30 × unpaid leave days) = round(13550 ÷ 30 × 1) = round(451.67) = 452
Labour Act s.126 cap on the absence deduction: 13550 × 2.5 ÷ 30 = 1129.17; 617 is within it
